survey.title: From Calibrated Classifiers to Decision Contracts: A Survey of System One Models

streams.name: Label-conditioned scoring heads
streams.summary: Classification over a declared label set, from pretrained encoders to entailment-based zero-shot classification and label-in-context models. Once labels are read as text, their wording and order become part of the input.

streams.name: Reward models, verifiers, judges and guardrail classifiers
streams.summary: Scorers that map a state and a set of candidates to a probability of preference, correctness or safety, together with the catalogue of biases that sway a model reading the candidates it must choose among.

streams.name: Proper scoring rules and calibrated training
streams.summary: Strictly proper scores, post-hoc calibration and calibration-aware rewards. Training against a proper score is training for calibration, which is the meaning of the decision model's promise.

streams.name: The reject option and its descendants
streams.gives: the policy that acts on the probability
streams.summary: The reject option, selective classification, learning to defer, conformal sets and model cascades. This stream turns a returned probability into an action such as act, review or escalate.

streams.name: Dual-process architectures and the System One name
streams.gives: the fast-solver role and the name
streams.summary: Dual-process accounts of reasoning and the fast and slow AI architectures that borrow them. The stream supplies the fast-solver role in a larger program and the System One label.

regularities.name: The contract travels
regularities.short: The contract travels, and robustness to option names belongs to the model family, so it must be tested per model.

regularities.name: Calibration is conditional
regularities.short: Calibration belongs to the model and the task together, and it is audited per schema.

regularities.name: The policy earns the saving
regularities.short: The unit that earns the saving is the escalation policy, not the decision model alone.
